Report this job Scope Core responsibilities to include Architecting, designing and supporting (along with counterparts, distinguished consultants and architects) a ground up cloud enabled SaaS product in Merchandise Management in retail space. The team currently comprises of 45+ global associates across India (COE), US and Mexico and is expected to grow rapidly. The incumbent will need to have good communication and leadership qualities, also mentor junior and mid-level associates in our team. Technical Environment Software: React JS, Node JS, Oracle PL/SQL, Rest API. Java script, Unix, Cognos. Application Architecture: Scalable three tier web application. Cloud Architecture: Private cloud, MS Azure (ARM templates, AKS, Application gateway, Virtue Networks, Event Hub, Azure AD) Frameworks/Others: GitHub, Jenkins, CI/CD, DevOps, JIRA, Service NOW Type ORM, Express. What You’ll Do Works in an agile team to create highly useful, easily maintainable software components that deliver maximum value to the customer. Closely interacts and collaborates with other team members on design, implementation, testing, and code review of user stories and bug fixes. Analyze software related issues and propose solutions Participate in team activities such as backlog grooming, planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. Keeps up to date with technology and research latest trends in the industry. Build customer specific interfaces and enhancements. Analyze customer reported defects and provide the solution. What We Are Looking For Bachelor’s degree (B.E/B. Tech/M. Tech/MCA in Computer Science or related specialization) and minimum 4 to 6 years of experience in Node JS Development. Experience with Scrum, Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, GitHub, Jenkins Strong communications skill. Hands-on programming experience and background in React JS Good to have exposure to Kafka, Snowflake Good to have PL/SQL, Oracle database. Good to have experience in Unix Batch scripting. Our Values If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Report this job Join our team and you will have an opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment. As an experienced Full Stack Engineer, you will join our Risk Technology team which supports Quantitative risk platforms enabling several middle and back-office teams globally. We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future. What role will you play? In this role, you will collaborate with stakeholders, analysts, and development teams to define requirements and deliver end-to-end software solutions, including testing, deployment, and upgrades. The role includes providing production support, working closely with users, and helping ensure system stability and performance. You'll drive platform enhancements, build strong stakeholder relationships, serve as a subject matter expert for complex issues, and uphold high standards of quality and professionalism. What You Offer 4+ of Strong experience in Java or Python Experience with modern user interface frameworks such as React or Angular Experience in RDBMS, SQL, JPA or Hibernate Experience with cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, EC2 and EKS) and continuous integration and delivery practices, including CI/CD pipelines and security controls Ability to use AI-assisted development tools, apply DevOps practices, manage incidents and stakeholders, and deliver in an agile environment. Experience on working with GRC Platforms such as SAS Viya MRM and OpenPages We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply. What We Offer Benefits At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include: 1 wellbeing leave day per year 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers Company-subsidised childcare services 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role Reimbursement for work from home equipment About Technology Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We’re a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow’s technology solutions. Inclusion at Macquarie We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance. We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. We are looking for exceptional programmers to join our Human Capital Development (HC Dev) team based out of Gurugram, Hyderabad or Bengaluru, which is rebuilding its core infrastructure and applications to enhance efficiency, enable data-driven decision-making, and deliver next-generation analytics capabilities. The role offers an opportunity to provide technical and delivery leadership through active involvement in system design, architecture, and implementation, leading initiatives that evolve our platforms, improve maintainability, and deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing systems. You will align technology direction with business goals, guide teams toward architectural excellence, and strengthen the reliability, resilience, and performance of critical systems. WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: In this role you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining high-quality web applications and supporting infrastructure by working closely with business and product managers. You will work on a range of back-end and front-end technologies including Java, Spring, TypeScript, React, and SQL Server, while participating actively in design and code reviews. You will remain hands-on in design and development while guiding the team in engineering best practices. You will also troubleshoot business-critical issues, solve complex technical challenges, and mentor junior team members on both technology and domain aspects to support their growth and development. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: The ideal candidate should hold- Basic qualifications: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field with 6 to 9 years of work experience Strong full-stack development experience with Java and Spring or similar frameworks on the back end, and TypeScript and React on the front end, with familiarity in SQL. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a demonstrated passion for technology, quality, and attention to detail. Proven experience in end-to-end project delivery, including planning, execution, and stakeholder communication; people management experience is a plus. Excellent reasoning ability, interpersonal, and communication skills, as the role involves frequent interaction with business groups. Advanced Qualifications: Experience integrating GenAI workflows, including RAG pipelines, using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or equivalent tools to build scalable AI applications is a plus. Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/LeadHCDevSept26 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative. The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.
